2026-09-27T11:31:54.3279590Z ##[group]Run if [ "${RUNNER_OS}" = "macOS" ]; then
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3279950Z if [ "${RUNNER_OS}" = "macOS" ]; then
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3280300Z   # The gate reports "not applicable here" with exit 77, the autotools
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3280730Z   # skip convention. 77 is still nonzero and this step runs under
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3281150Z   # `bash -e`, so calling it bare turns every skip into a failure of the
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3281560Z   # REQUIRED macos check — and aborts before `cmake --build`, so the
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3281960Z   # build the check exists to run never happens either. The skip is
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3282340Z   # reachable in practice, not theoretical: the gate needs the
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3282720Z   # iphonesimulator and iphoneos SDKs, and tart-provision.sh
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3283130Z   # deliberately trims simulator payload from the golden image.
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3283560Z   # Distinguish skip from failure; a real gate failure must still red
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3283900Z   # the check.
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3284150Z   if [ "$IOS_COMPILE_REQUIRED" = false ]; then
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3284580Z     echo "::notice::iOS compile gate skipped by exact changed-surface authorization"
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3284900Z   else
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3285070Z     set +e
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3285270Z     bash test/cmake/test_ios_compile_gate.sh \
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3285560Z       "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" "$PULP_BUILD_DIR-ios"
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3285810Z     ios_gate_rc=$?
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3285990Z     set -e
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3286180Z     if [ "$ios_gate_rc" = 77 ]; then
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3286560Z       echo "::notice::iOS compile gate skipped (exit 77) — required SDKs absent on this runner"
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3286950Z     elif [ "$ios_gate_rc" != 0 ]; then
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3287280Z       echo "::error::iOS compile gate failed (exit ${ios_gate_rc})"
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3287580Z       exit "$ios_gate_rc"
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3287780Z     fi
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3287930Z   fi
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3288080Z fi
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3288330Z # Parallelism is DERIVED here, never a literal. This one step runs on
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3288740Z # runners with different shapes — self-hosted macOS gate VMs sized by
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3289230Z # their tartci lease, GitHub-hosted Linux/Windows/macOS, and an
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3289630Z # external contributor's checkout — and no single number is correct
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3290040Z # for all of them. A literal is also a silent ceiling: it keeps its
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3290440Z # value when a VM is resized, so the resize buys nothing and the
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3290780Z # no-op reads as "more cores did not help".
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3291030Z #
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3291270Z # The governor bounds the build by min(cores, RAM/1.5GiB): it takes a
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3291730Z # tartci lease share where a lease store exists, and falls back to
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3292140Z # that tier-0 bound where none does (inside a build VM, or a plain
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3292560Z # checkout). It never fails the build for a missing or denied lease,
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3293010Z # so this is safe on every leg including a fork PR. It passes no
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3293460Z # -j itself — CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL from the wrapper governs,
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3293850Z # which is why no --parallel flag belongs on the governed command.
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3294150Z #
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3294410Z # Windows keeps a literal, and that is not an oversight. The governor
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3295250Z # exists to divide a SHARED host; the Windows leg is a GitHub-hosted
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3295730Z # ephemeral 4-core runner that shares with nobody, so a literal that
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3296190Z # matches a fixed runner shape is already correct there. It is also
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3296600Z # the one leg this PR cannot prove: `windows` is excluded from the
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3297000Z # `pull_request` and `merge_group` matrices (see the matrix builder
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3297380Z # above), so it runs only on push/nightly/dispatch — and no workflow
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3297770Z # runs this wrapper under MSYS bash today, where a checked-out .sh
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3298140Z # does not carry a filesystem exec bit. Do not fold these branches
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3298540Z # together without first proving that path on a dispatch run.
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3298860Z if [ "${RUNNER_OS}" = "Windows" ]; then
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3299180Z   cmake --build "$PULP_BUILD_DIR" --config Release --parallel 4
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3299490Z else
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3299830Z   tools/ci/governed-build.sh cmake --build "$PULP_BUILD_DIR" --config Release
2026-09-27T11:31:54.3300220Z fi
